result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly functional, but there are a few visual issues related to loading states and content truncation.

issues.description: The 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' image in the 'Popular right now' section shows a loading spinner overlay, indicating the image has not finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images fully load before display, or add a proper placeholder/skeleton state to avoid showing spinners over partially loaded content.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) has truncated restaurant name text that is cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal scroll layout or card spacing so restaurant names are fully readable, or allow the truncated card to indicate more content via clearer partial visibility.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off, showing only the top portion of the image with no visible title or details.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for scrollable content, but ensure enough of the next item is shown to signal scrollability without appearing broken.
